 Who we are 
 CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.
 
 Job Summary 
We are looking for a Cloud Application Developer to build MuleSoft integrations on Amazon EKS and client interfaces through the API Module, for key initiatives supporting our client. 
 Job Description 
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Cloud Applications Developer to join our IT team. This position will be full-time, hybrid, and is a contract position. Must be able to work onsite in Trenton, NJ, 3 days per week. 
 What You'll Do 
 Build, deploy, and support MuleSoft integrations running on Amazon EKS for the NJ DCF HR Modernization initiative
 Develop NJ Client interfaces, REST APIs, DataWeave transformations, and event-driven services using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and PostgreSQL (RDS)
 Write automated unit tests, support CI/CD pipelines, maintain documentation, and collaborate with developers, architects, and QA teams to ensure high-quality integrations and successful deployments
 What You'll Need 
 Required:
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
 5+ years of software development experience
 Hands-on experience with MuleSoft Development, including DataWeave
 Experience deploying applications to Amazon EKS/Kubernetes
 Experience with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, PostgreSQL RDS, REST API development, automated testing, and Git-based development workflows
 Desired:
 Event-driven architectures, external write gateway integrations, AWS Certified Developer Associate, MuleSoft Certified Developer, child welfare/human services systems experience, and State of New Jersey agency experience.
 Physical Demands 
 Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA and other federal, state, and local standards
 Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings, etc
 Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor
